description: This file declares functions for starting a secure environment involving remote keymaster and gatekeeper components, with support for both pipe names and handles, and includes platform-specific DLL import/export macros.

methods.name: StartSecureEnv
methods.description: Starts and runs remote keymaster and gatekeeper in separate threads using pipe names, performing cryptography in software.

methods.name: StartSecureEnvWithHandles
methods.description: Starts and runs remote keymaster and gatekeeper using handles to preexisting named pipes.
